auth.title: Admin Login
auth.subtitle: Please enter your credentials to open the control panel.
auth.invalidCredentials: The username or password is invalid.

sidebar.title: Admin Panel
sidebar.subtitle: Control the scoreboard, audio and tournament flow from one place.

summary.title: Live Score
summary.description: Current teams, score and clock at a glance.

display.title: Projector Display
display.description: Switch between live score and bracket on the projector.
display.bracketHint: Note: a tournament must be set in the match context for the bracket.

context.title: Match Context
context.description: Set the tournament, stage and label for the current live mode.
context.suggestionsTip: Tip: known labels automatically set the matching stage.
context.placeholderDefault: e.g. Quarter-final or match for place 3 / 4

scheduleIntegration.title: Apply Scheduled Match
scheduleIntegration.description: Apply teams, stage and match code directly from the schedule.
scheduleIntegration.resultNotice: Note: a result already exists for this match ({{scoreA}}:{{scoreB}}).

teamSelection.title: Select Teams
teamSelection.description: Choose existing teams or manage free team names for the scoreboard.

score.title: Score
score.description: Quick +/- actions or manual correction of the score.

timer.title: Game Clock & Flow
timer.description: Manage the clock, halves and extra time. Start, pause or finish games centrally.

penalties.title: Time Penalties
penalties.description: Manage penalties per team. Optionally assign players and keep track of running times.

bulk.title: Schedule Matches
bulk.descriptionNoTournament: Select a tournament first to edit dates.
bulk.noMatches: No matches in the schedule yet.
bulk.description: Bulk actions for setting dates, times and saving the schedule.
bulk.applyDateDescription: Sets the date only – times are preserved.
bulk.autoPlanDescription: Assigns start times automatically – perfect for fixed intervals (e.g. every 12 minutes).
bulk.saveDescription: Saves all changed dates to the database at once.

planner.title: Schedule Matches
planner.description: Set date and time for all fixtures to structure the match day.
planner.noMatches: No matches in the schedule yet.

audio.controlDescription: Choose sounds for game events or trigger audio manually – ideal for commentary and arena atmosphere.
audio.triggersDescription: Assign matching sounds to each event, test them or quickly mute triggers.
audio.timerDescription: Configure when the warning signal, countdown beeps and final buzzer are triggered. Sounds are assigned above under 'Game Event Sounds'.
audio.warningHint: Seconds before the end of the game
audio.countdownHint: Seconds before the end (one beep per second)
audio.libraryDescription: Manage all available audio files and start sounds manually.

history.title: History
history.description: Edit or delete archived games. Ideal for validating results and tournament statistics.

players.createDescription: Create players for the statistics and assign them to teams. Afterwards, point actions can be attributed to players.
players.listDescription: Edit or delete players. Assign unassigned players to teams so they can be used on the scoreboard.

teams.organizeDescription: Create new teams or edit existing ones. They are available in the scoreboard and tournament structure.
teams.listDescription: Update team names or remove teams that are no longer needed.

tournaments.createDescription: Define name, number of groups, knockout rounds and visibility for new tournaments.
tournaments.name: Tournament name
tournaments.listDescription: Edit tournament parameters or delete competitions that are no longer needed.

details.title: Tournament Details
details.noStructure: No structure available yet. Please update the tournament or reload the structure.
